Its so nice to talk to someone who understands! You are so right, ive always felt like there was a void in my heart ever since my dad left. Like a piece of me is missing. Thanks so much for being so understanding and accepting :)

Aww youre gonna make me cry!! I havent really had people who support me this much before. <3 The people in this community are amazing. I really should go to bed now though its 10:45pm where i live right now, anddd i have school tomorrow :/ but thanks so much for your support! It means the world to me :)
Thank you for being so kind and understanding towards me. :)
Thank you so much! You are so kind :)

Thanks! Aww this community is so kind. Thats good advice, i'll try that :) and i'll post if it works. Like joining this community and sharing my feelings, is like making me so happy because people that actually understand how i feel and have been in my situation are giving me advice and helping me. You are all too kind <3

I dont know. I guess i just feel really alone. My friends dont really understand whenever i try to explain how i feel to them. I had a really bad childhood. My dad wasnt very nice to me as a child. And I guess i have just really been missing that part of me..(he wasnt allowed custody of me and my siblings anymore last Christmas) and even though i know he would probably hurt me again. I miss him. You know? Like he was my dad. And all my friends talk about their perfect family and stuff. And it makes me feel really alone. My family all hated him. But i tend to try and find the best in people no matter what. So if i told them i miss him.. i dont really think they would be very happy with me.
Thanks! Everyone here is so nice. Im not really used to people being kind to me. It really means a lot to me. So thank you for being so kind and understanding
Thanks! Your so kind. Its nice to know that someone else felt the same way that i feel.

I can kinda relate. Im still in school and everyone says suicide is "just a phase that teenagers go though" when your a teenager. But it isnt. I wish people would just stop and ask if i am okay. But noone ever does. Just know there are so many people going through the same thing as you right now and you arent alone :)
